description: ETFS_SETUP ETF-universe -- the ETFs whose per-partner daily ownership the producers compute and AVGCAP averages. To add an ETF: append its ticker to 'tickers' (runtime-read by the producers' _load_universe; no redeploy). Shared across all ETFS_SETUP producers (Inflection W1 / 49F W2 / Cottonwood W3).
